verdict.rationale: cubic's review automations (review behavior, ignore patterns, PR descriptions, custom agents) are defined in a repo-root `cubic.yaml` that serves as the source of truth. An org-wide `cubic-config` repository can supply defaults. Because this config lives in Git, it can be versioned and reviewed through normal PRs, and auto-approval can be trialed in shadow mode before going live. Versioning, review and rollback are implied by Git rather than provided as a documented cubic capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of versioning, review or rollback for automation config (e.g. history, diff, revert of rules), config validation or preview beyond auto-approval shadow mode, and independent corroboration.
